nine_item_selection_note: Exact earlier list of nine was NOT FOUND. This audit explicitly selects MgO, FeO-T and SO3 at each of three stations; all three SiO2 values are supplied separately to remove ambiguity. No claim of scientific-value ranking.
scope: Reported abrasion-patch measurements near the sample sites, not measurements of an entire36m CRISM pixel. Values are PIXL XRF oxide-equivalent mass fractions as reported, not inferred mineral abundances. No cross-instrument agreement or disagreement inferred.
